Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# more surgical: alter chunk-offset / sparse frame markers near header while preserving size
for idx in [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7, 40,41,42,43,44,45,46,47, 120,121,122,123,124,125,126,127]:
    if idx < len(b): b[idx] ^= 0xFF
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('done')
PY

  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_decompress_frame.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":21,"var":"data,size","code":"blosc2_schunk* schunk = blosc2_schunk_from_buffer((uint8_t *) data, size, false);","note":"The fuzzer hands attacker-controlled bytes to the frame parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"blosc/schunk.c","function":"blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk","line":804,"var":"schunk->frame","code":"chunksize = frame_decompress_chunk(schunk->dctx, frame, nchunk, dest, nbytes);","note":"The parsed frame is used in chunk decompression."},
  {"step":3,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":2761,"var":"frame,nchunk","code":"rc = frame_get_lazychunk(frame, nchunk, &src, &needs_free);","note":"The selected chunk is fetched as a lazychunk buffer."},
  {"step":4,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1887,"var":"frame","code":"rc = get_header_info(frame, &header_len, &frame_len, &nbytes, &cbytes, &blocksize, &chunksize, &nchunks, &typesize, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);","note":"Header metadata from the input frame is decoded and determines frame layout."},
  {"step":5,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1910,"var":"offset","code":"rc = get_coffset(frame, header_len, cbytes, nchunk, &offset);","note":"The offset for the requested chunk is computed from that metadata."},
  {"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1953,"var":"*chunk,needs_free","code":"*chunk = malloc(lazychunk_cbytes); *needs_free = true;","note":"A heap buffer is allocated when the frame is file-backed."},
  {"step":7,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1975,"var":"*chunk","code":"rbytes = fread(*chunk, 1, trailer_offset, fp);","note":"The crafted bytes are copied into the heap lazychunk buffer."},
  {"step":8,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":2016,"var":"trailer_csizes,block_csizes","code":"void *trailer_csizes = *chunk + lazychunk_cbytes - nblocks * sizeof(int32_t); memcpy(trailer_csizes, block_csizes, nblocks * sizeof(int32_t));","note":"Trailing block sizes are synthesized from metadata, and corruption here can poison the temporary object."},
  {"step":9,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":2793,"var":"src","code":"if (needs_free) { free(src); }","note":"The heap-backed lazychunk is released at the sink, which is the invalid-free site of interest."}
]
